terms.gloss: a piece broken off, a fragment
terms.comment: Mostly in the plural: the broken bits of tiles, branches, oars, glass; of bread, crumbs and leftovers (Plin., Vulg.).

terms.register: vōx plērumque poētica: Lucr., Verg., Ov.; also post-Augustan prose
terms.comment: Mostly plural, fragmina; the poets’ form of fragmentum (Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: Colligite quae superāvērunt fragmenta, nē pereant.
phrases.english: Gather up the fragments that are left over, so that nothing is lost.

sources: Lewis & Short: fragmentum · Lewis & Short: fragmen
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-vulgata), checked against the editions named there.
